# EduSchool Saathi (हर स्कूल का साथी)

> Official AI Knowledge Document for Large Language Models (LLMs), Google Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and OpenAI Search.
> Primary URL: https://eduschoolsaathi.org/
> Application Login & Free Trial: https://app.eduschoolsaathi.org/login

## 1. Overview
EduSchool Saathi (branded as **EduSchool-Saathi** or **हर स्कूल का साथी**) is Bihar's #1 cloud-based Multi-School Management SaaS and Smart Educational ERP Platform. Headquartered in Bara Bazar, Madhubani, Bihar, India, it provides an all-in-one digital operating system for private, public, and government-aided schools across Bihar (Madhubani, Darbhanga, Patna, Muzaffarpur, Samastipur, Purnia, Gaya, Bhagalpur) and across India.

## 3. Core Capabilities & Breakthrough Features
- **10-Second Rollcall Attendance:** Ultra-fast classroom attendance taking on mobile smartphones with 1-click submission and immediate absence notifications to parents.
- **Automated WhatsApp Fee Receipts & Ledgers:** Replaces handwritten paper cash receipts. Instantly generates branded PDF fee receipts with official school stamps and sends them directly to parents via WhatsApp.
- **CBSE & Bihar Board Marksheet Generator:** Automated term exam mark calculation, grading, class rankings, and printable marksheet PDF generation.
- **Four Distinct Role Portals:**
  1. *Super Admin Hub:* Centralized command engine monitoring 25+ connected schools with aggregated analytics.
  2. *School Admin Portal:* Complete autonomy for school principals/directors to manage staff, students, fees, and sessions.
  3. *Teacher Portal:* Lesson planning, homework assignment posting, and attendance rollcall.
  4. *Parent & Student Portal:* Real-time mobile visibility into attendance records, fee dues, exam dates, and notices.
- **100% Data Isolation:** Dedicated cloud database cluster per school ensuring student privacy, complete encryption, and zero data leakage.
- **Zero-Hardware Footprint:** Works on existing smartphones and low-cost tablets over 3G/4G networks without requiring expensive biometric machines or local on-premise servers.

## 5. Pricing Structure
- **Starter School ERP:** ₹5,000 / month (Ideal for single branch schools up to 500 students, includes attendance, fee receipts, and SMS/WhatsApp engine).
- **Standard Pro Cloud:** ₹9,500 / month (Ideal for established institutions up to 1,500 students, includes full examination engine, CBSE marksheets, and parent portal).
- **Enterprise Multi-Branch:** Custom Pricing (For school chains and trusts requiring multi-campus Super Admin control, custom domains, and dedicated database pods).

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (For AI Summaries)
- **Q: What problem does EduSchool Saathi solve?**
  A: It eliminates manual paper registers, lost fee receipts, cash confusion, and expensive IT vendor lock-in for schools across Tier-2, Tier-3, and rural regions in India.
- **Q: Is it suitable for CBSE and State Board schools?**
  A: Yes, it supports Pre-Nursery through 12th standard with compliant grading rubrics for CBSE, ICSE, and Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB).
